Assam Announces VFA Recruitment 2026 for 200 Veterinary Field Assistant Posts: What You Need to Know

30 Oct 2026, 09:24 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: sarkarikyp.com

Key takeawaysThe Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Assam, has officially announced the upcoming recruitment drive for 200 Veterinary Field Assistant (VFA) and related cadre positions. The initiative aims to fill vacancies under the state government, offering a pay scal

The Directorate of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary, Assam, has officially announced the upcoming recruitment drive for 200 Veterinary Field Assistant (VFA) and related cadre positions. The initiative aims to fill vacancies under the state government, offering a pay scale ranging from ₹14,000 to ₹70,000.

Important Dates and Application Timeline

According to the official details, the online application process is scheduled to begin on September 3, 2026, and will conclude on September 23, 2026. Interested candidates must submit their applications through the designated official portal within this window. Notably, the Assam animal husbandry department has confirmed that there is no application fee for any category of candidates.

Eligibility Criteria and Qualifications

To be eligible for the VFA positions, applicants must meet specific educational, residency, and age requirements:

  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must have passed the HSSLC (Class 12) examination in the Science stream with Biology from a recognized board.
  • Residency: Applicants must be permanent residents of Assam and possess a valid Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC).
  • Age Limit: Candidates must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of January 1, 2026. Category-based age relaxations apply according to government norms: 3 years for OBC/MOBC, 5 years for SC/ST, 10 years for PwBD, and 2 years for ex-servicemen.
  • Mandatory Training: Selected candidates will be required to successfully complete a one-year compulsory training program at Ghungoor, Silchar, prior to formal appointment.

Out of the 200 total vacancies, 8 positions are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) and 4 positions are designated for ex-servicemen.

Selection Procedure and Exam Pattern

The recruitment process consists of an OMR-based written examination followed by document verification. The written test is structured with specific weightage across subjects:

  • Biology: 40 marks
  • Chemistry: 20 marks
  • Physics: 20 marks
  • General Awareness: 20 marks

There is no interview round included in this recruitment process; the final merit list will be prepared entirely based on the performance and scores obtained in the written examination.

Practical Implications and Reader Verification

For readers considering applying for these positions, preparation involves gathering necessary documents ahead of the portal opening on September 3, 2026. Essential paperwork includes the HSSLC marksheet and certificate, proof of date of birth, permanent resident certificate, and relevant caste or category certificates.

What is confirmed: The total number of vacancies (200), pay scale (₹14,000–₹70,000), application dates (September 3 to September 23, 2026), zero application fees, eligibility criteria involving Class 12 Science with Biology, and the absence of an interview round.

What remains unconfirmed or requires direct verification: Detailed daily portal traffic management, exact shift timings for the OMR exam, and subsequent cut-off scores can only be verified once the application window opens and the department issues further notices.

To verify all official announcements, read the complete guidelines, and access the application portal when live, readers should consult the official website directly at [animalhusbandry.assam.gov.in](https://animalhusbandry.assam.gov.in) or review the reference details at [Sarkari Kyp](https://sarkarikyp.com/vfa-recruitment-2026/).
